An International Journal of Algal Research'' 28: 1-29. * ''Lucernaria'' Roussel, 1806{{cite web |url=http://www.algaebase.org/search/genus/detail/?genus_id=ydea6a3c42bbcd3da |title=Algaebase, entry for ''Lucernaria'' |access-date=20 February 2016}} * ''Pleurodiscus'' Lagerheim, 1895{{cite web |url=http://www.algaebase.org/search/genus/detail/?genus_id=Jca4863616675e2ac&sk=0 |title=Algaebase, entry for ''Pleurodiscus'' |access-date=9 September 2014}} * ''Rhynchonema'' Kützing, 1849 * ''Stellulina'' Link, 1833 * ''Thwaitesia'' Montagne, 1845 * ''Tyndaridea'' Bory de Saint-Vincent 1822 * '''Tendaridea''' Bory de Saint-Vincent 1822 * ''Tendaridella'' Gaillon, 1833 }} '''''Zygnema''''' is a genus of [[freshwater]] filamentous [[wikt:thalloid|thalloid]] [[alga]] comprising about 100 species.{{cite web|last=Guiry|first=M.D.|last2=Guiry|first2=G.M.|year=2008| title=Zygnema|work=[[AlgaeBase]]|publisher=World-wide electronic publication, National University of Ireland, Galway|url=http://www.algaebase.org/search/genus/detail/?genus_id=43566|access-date= 2009-02-21}} A terrestrial species, ''Z. terrestre'', is known from India. ''Zygnema'' grows as a free-floating mass of filaments, although young plants may be found anchored to streambeds with a [[Holdfast (biology)|holdfast]]. The filaments form a yellow-green to bright green colored tangled mat, and are composed of elongate barrel-shaped cells, each with two star-shaped (stellate) [[chloroplast]]s arrayed along the axis of the cell. == Species == Some species include: *[[Zygnema atrocoeruleum|''Z. atrocoeruleum'']] *[[Zygnema binuclearioides|''Z. binuclearioides'']] *[[Zygnema carinthiacum|''Z. carinthiacum'']] *[[Zygnema carteri|''Z. carteri'']] *[[Zygnema circumcarinatum|''Z. circumcarinatum'']] *[[Zygnema coeruleum|''Z. coeruleum'']] *[[Zygnema conspicuum|''Z. conspicuum'']] *[[Zygnema cruciatum|''Z. cruciatum'']] *[[Zygnema cyanosphaeroidicum|''Z. cyanosphaeroidicum'']] *[[Zygnema cylindricum|''Z. cylindricum'']] *[[Zygnema cylindrospermum|''Z. cylindrospermum'']] *[[Zygnema fanicum|''Z. fanicum'']] *[[Zygnema gorakhporense|''Z. gorakhporense'']] *[[Zygnema insigne|''Z. insigne'']] *[[Zygnema kashmirense|''Z. kashmirense'']] *[[Zygnema kiangsiense|''Z. kiangsiense'']] *[[Zygnema leiospermum|''Z. leiospermum'']] *[[Zygnema melanosporum|''Z. melanosporum'']] *[[Zygnema momoniense|''Z. momoniense'']] *[[Zygnema normanii|''Z. normanii'']] *[[Zygnema oveidanum|''Z. oveidanum'']] *[[Zygnema pectinatum|''Z. pectinatum'']] *[[Zygnema peliosporum|''Z. peliosporum'']] *[[Zygnema quadrispirale|''Z. quadrispirale'']] *[[Zygnema ralfsii|''Z. ralfsii'']] *[[Zygnema rivulare|''Z. rivulare'']] *[[Zygnema ruviatum|''Z. ruviatum'']] *[[Zygnema schwabei|''Z. schwabei'']] *[[Zygnema spontaneum|''Z. spontaneum'']] *[[Zygnema stagnale|''Z. stagnale'']] *[[Zygnema stellinum|''Z. stellinum'']] *[[Zygnema subtile|''Z. subtile'']] *[[Zygnema tenue|''Z. tenue'']] *[[Zygnema tenuissimum|''Z. tenuissimum'']] *[[Zygnema terrestre|''Z. terrestre'']] *[[Zygnema vaginatum|''Z. vaginatum'']] *[[Zygnema vaucherii|''Z. vaucherii'']] *[[Zygnema verrucosum|''Z. verrucosum'']] == References == {{Reflist}} {{Taxonbar|from=Q150137}} [[Category:Zygnemataceae]] [[Category:Charophyta genera]] {{green alga-stub}}
